notes: Write to car from the Type and codes table: double-click a code to add or remove it, and with the car connected E-Sys MAX asks once whether to write the vehicle order now. It lists what changed, saves a copy first, then writes the order and its vehicle profile (FP) with a progress window; no need to go to VCM. The Write to car button does the same after several changes. The toolbar now has Type and codes in FA helper's place (FA helper is in the E-Sys MAX menu). A changed vehicle order is saved and written with MODIFIED in its name. Write vehicle order: Take me there now opens the VCM page and asks, and when E-Sys keeps Write FA FP off, E-Sys MAX calculates the vehicle profile first. NCD compare shows once (on the toolbar). The codes lists no longer leave old tooltip boxes behind while scrolling.
